proposal.description: fault_cause logs the overcurrent cause from the live synchronised CP comparator instead of fault_arbiter's RUN window trip, so a single valley-current excursion counts as an overcurrent fault
proposal.reason: In S_SS or S_RUN, a CP_trig pulse too short to reach trip_run sets FAULT_REG bit 0 and latches fault_time. In the original, nothing is logged because the supervisor never left S_RUN.

proposal.description: strike_counter breaks its clean-run streak on any CP comparator assertion instead of on the window trip, so 'fault-free' is taken to mean no overcurrent cycle at all
proposal.reason: After a hiccup, isolated CP_trig pulses in S_RUN that stay below trip_run keep resetting clean_counter, so strike_level is never cleared. Red_LED1 keeps blinking, the STRIKE_LEVEL read stays non-zero, later cool-downs are longer, and latch_out trips one hiccup sooner than it should.

proposal.description: fault_LED's strikes-outstanding input is wired to the configured strike limit max_strikes instead of the accumulated strike_level
proposal.reason: With the default non-zero max_strikes and no latch, Red_LED1 blinks from reset onward, even with no hiccup. It also never reflects real strikes when the host has set the limit to 0.

proposal.description: fault_LED's running input takes the qualified PGOOD instead of run_active, so the green LED treats 'rail in regulation' as 'running'
proposal.reason: From entering S_RUN until pgood_gen finishes PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES qualifying cycles, and whenever PGOOD_comp dips in S_RUN, Green_LED is dark. In the original it stays lit.

proposal.description: fault_LED's soft-start input is wired to hiccup_active, so the green 'running' LED covers the hiccup cool-down instead of soft start
proposal.reason: In S_HICCUP with no live hard fault, Green_LED lights although En is low. Through all of S_SS it stays dark, while the original lights it.

proposal.description: soft_start's hold branch is keyed on its own SS_done ('ramp finished') instead of S_RUN, so once a ramp completes it is never reset to the floor
proposal.reason: After a first ramp and a later hiccup or turn-off, SS_done stays high and max_on_counts stays at max_on_limit. The retry's S_SS goes straight to S_RUN on the next clock, and PWM_out is passed at full ceiling with no re-ramp.
